description: Copy a whole notebook — its sources and Studio artifacts — into a new notebook. RPC-backed. Returns the new notebook id and URL. The sources are copied in the background and may not be listed in the reply yet — call list_sources a few seconds later. Only a notebook you own can be copied (not one shared with you or public). Not idempotent: a failure is never retried automatically, so check the notebook list before retrying.

title.description: Title of the copy. Defaults to "Copy of <source title>".

name: notebook_copy

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
